title: A House for the Harvest
author: Petra Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Ishikawa, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
